lines.text: Paul asks the brothers to pray that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor.
Paul asks them to pray that his team will be delivered from wicked and evil men.
The Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen the believers and guard them from the evil one.
Paul has confidence in the law that the believers are doing and will continue to do what he commands.
Paul prays that the Lord will direct their hearts into God's love and Christ's wisdom.
